_about: Facts true of one specific file, kept out of the splitters' code (to-do-list.md, A3). The ICAI compilation holds several laws in one PDF. Each part gets its own name, so its units get their own ids (CGST and IGST Rules both have a rule 2). Pages are the PDF's own, 1-based, inclusive; Rules checked by the user in Preview 2026-11-03, Acts by their title pages 2026-11-04. The CGST Act comes from India Code (act.py). The IGST, UTGST and Compensation Acts come from here for now (decided 2026-11-04, so v1 needn't wait for the India Code downloads; ICAI is unofficial but as of 31-03-2026); swap them for India Code copies later if wanted. Pages left out: 1-19 front matter and index, 20-181 the CGST Act (used only as icai.py's held-out test), 182-183 ICAI's notes, 436-440 the Constitution (101st Amendment) Act, 2016 (not in v1's scope), 441-442 blank and ICAI's address.
